facts.fact: The African Union Commission's status list of 02/02/2026 records Cape Verde's ratification or accession to the Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection as dated 13/11/2020, with no date of signature.

facts.fact: The African Union Commission's status list of 02/02/2026 records the date Cape Verde deposited its instrument for the Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection as 05/02/2022.

facts.fact: The Boletim Oficial of 17 March 2020 lists Resolution 153/IX/2020 of the National Assembly, which approves for accession the African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection; the document gives no approval date, so its publication date is used.

facts.fact: ECOWAS says Cabo Verde is a signatory to the adoption of the ECOWAS National Biometric Identity Card, while Cabo Verde's own officials say a legal review and a political decision are needed before it adopts it.
ECOWAS says the 16th NRA focal points meeting validated Cabo Verde operators' roaming tariffs as in line with Regulation C/REG.21/12/17.
